name: Canned Coffee
blurb: Every known world spawn for Canned Coffee, grouped by region. Directions and photos are added by hand.

containers.note: Canned Coffee is placed directly in the world at kitchens, diners and camps (fixed spawns); a small number of food containers can also hold one.

consumption.note: Canned Coffee is a food consumable. It grants no timed stat buff on its own.
